findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "experimentation" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: experimentation_guardrail-check · Public sink: experimentation_ab-test-frequentist, experimentation_bayesian-ab, experimentation_sequential-test, experimentation_cuped-adjust, experimentation_sample-ratio-mismatch, experimentation_sample-size-mde, experimentation_multiple-testing-correct, experimentation_delta-method-ratio, experimentation_bandit-allocate, experimentation_bucket-assign, experimentation_flag-rule-evaluate, experimentation_novelty-effect-detect, experimentation_segment-lift, experimentation_guardrail-check, experimentation_holdout-impact · Destructive: experimentation_ab-test-frequentist, experimentation_bayesian-ab, experimentation_sequential-test, experimentation_cuped-adjust, experimentation_sample-ratio-mismatch, experimentation_sample-size-mde, experimentation_multiple-testing-correct, experimentation_delta-method-ratio, experimentation_bandit-allocate, experimentation_bucket-assign, experimentation_flag-rule-evaluate, experimentation_novelty-effect-detect, experimentation_segment-lift, experimentation_guardrail-check, experimentation_holdout-impact.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
